scope: PKT-09A starter executable skill package registry, route output, package schemas, Conductor and dual-provider worker package briefs, evidence ledger shape, and superpowers runtime dependency boundary.

checklist.approval_boundary: pass: package route fields preserve packet_workflow_human authority and do not grant Ready For Code, closeout, release, or superpowers removal authority.
checklist.provider_neutrality: pass: supported surfaces include Codex App, Claude Code App, Codex CLI, and Claude Code CLI without making any provider the product identity.
checklist.external_plugin_dependency: pass: package descriptors and route output report no superpowers runtime dependency.
checklist.skill_authority: pass: descriptors reference the starter catalog, not human-readable SKILL.md files as package authority.
checklist.ledger_trust: pass: route output records selected and skipped package decisions, and SkillPackageLedger.append records sanitized package-use state to JSONL.
checklist.context_budget: pass: selected package descriptor slices are returned without loading full skill bodies.
checklist.secret_handling: pass: route output and ledger entries redact secret-like intent text and keep a digest instead of raw token-bearing text.
checklist.destructive_command: pass: no destructive command path was added or broadened.
checklist.dependency_supply_chain: pass: no third-party dependency, lockfile, install script, GitHub Action, or mandatory external plugin was added.

remediated_findings: Router now fail-closes on package registry diagnostics before Conductor/worker handoff.
Route and package schemas were strengthened around authority, ledger, package descriptor, conductor brief, worker brief, and no-superpowers fields.
Secret-like intent text is redacted before route output and ledger persistence.
deferred_risks: Live provider CLI execution is outside PKT-09A scope and remains dependent on local user-managed provider authentication.
Superpowers plugin removal is explicitly Human-owned after reviewing PKT-09A evidence.
residual_risk: Low after package descriptor validation, route regression tests, full starter unittest discovery, root harness tests, strict validation, and scoped dependency audit.
